clusters.headline: Special Parliament Session To Debate Delimitation And Quota Bills
aiSummaryBullets: The Union Cabinet is finalizing amendments to the delimitation and women's reservation bills ahead of the upcoming special parliamentary sitting.
Opposition leaders, including Akhilesh Yadav and figures from the Congress party, have voiced strong objections to the timing and status of the legislation.

clusters.headline: Political Clash Intensifies Across India On Constitution Day
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP and Congress engaged in mutual accusations of undermining constitutional values during commemorations.
Union Minister Amit Shah criticized Congress leadership regarding the status of the Women's Reservation Bill.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Bihar Move To Release Anand Mohan From Prison
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court annulled the Bihar government's decision to grant premature release to former MP Anand Mohan.
Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu ruled that the state's modification of prison regulations for his early exit was unconstitutional.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court To Review Tirupparankundram Karthigai Deepam Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court is set to review a legal dispute concerning the traditional lamp-lighting ceremony during the Karthigai Deepam festival.
Tensions at the Tirupparankundram hilltop temple have increased following a failure to light the ceremonial deepam.

clusters.headline: Political Backlash Grows Against TVK MLA Over Harassment Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: A four-member panel has been established to investigate sexual harassment allegations filed by an IAS officer against Kallakurichi MLA C Arul Vignesh.
Opposition parties, including AIADMK and DMK, have staged protests and called for a CBI inquiry, while some political leaders advise against further escalation.

clusters.headline: Nandini Curd Price Reduced In Karnataka Following Public Backlash
aiSummaryBullets: The retail price for Nandini curd has been lowered by Rs 2 per kilogram.
The adjustment follows reports of public dissatisfaction regarding earlier cost increases.

clusters.headline: DMK MLA Vasantham Karthikeyan Booked For Harassing Woman Officer
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement booked DMK legislator Vasantham Karthikeyan regarding allegations of harassment involving a woman government officer.
The incident reportedly occurred in Kallakurichi, leading to an official case against the lawmaker.

clusters.headline: Congress And Samajwadi Party Face Friction Over Uttar Pradesh Seats
aiSummaryBullets: Seat-sharing negotiations between Congress and the Samajwadi Party in Uttar Pradesh remain deadlocked amid internal disputes.
The Samajwadi Party released a manifesto focused on youth, employment, and agricultural issues while facing criticism from other political figures.

clusters.headline: Mediation Fails In Sunjay Kapur Family Trust Dispute Over Assets
aiSummaryBullets: Court-ordered mediation in the Sunjay Kapur family trust dispute has ended without an agreement.
The legal matter involves claims regarding the value and management of assets within the family trust.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Hears Contempt Pleas Against Vijay Government On Deepam
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court is hearing contempt pleas following reports that the government lit the Deepam outside the court-approved location.
Priests maintain the Deepam was lit at the traditional hilltop site, citing customary practices for the festival.

clusters.headline: Centre Confirms Look Out Circular Issued Against Saurav Das
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian government confirmed to the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular has been issued against Saurav Das.
Authorities stated that document discrepancies, specifically concerning a passport, may impact his citizenship status.

clusters.headline: Tata Trusts Challenges N Chandrasekaran Reappointment In Court
aiSummaryBullets: Tata Trusts filed a legal challenge in the Bombay High Court against the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons chairman.
The organization claims the reappointment process violates the internal Articles of Association of the company.

clusters.headline: At Least 24 People Killed In Bus-Truck Collision In Assam State
aiSummaryBullets: A collision involving a bus and a truck occurred in Assam, India.
The incident resulted in at least 24 confirmed fatalities.

clusters.headline: Assam Man Rahul Roy Arrested For Alleged Rape Of Nine-Year-Old
aiSummaryBullets: Rahul Roy was apprehended by authorities in Assam after being accused of raping a nine-year-old child.
The suspect had reportedly established a rapport with the victim, who referred to him as 'Baba'.

clusters.headline: India Rejects US Manufacturing Claims Amid New Trade Tariff Threats
aiSummaryBullets: The United States has proposed a 25% tariff on Indian goods following a trade probe into manufacturing capacity.
Indian officials have officially denied allegations of excess manufacturing capacity in domestic sectors.

clusters.headline: Yogi Adityanath Addresses Political Criticism Following Family Loss
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath attended his mother's final rites in Haridwar following her passing at age 91.
The Chief Minister has engaged in verbal exchanges with political rivals, including criticism directed at the Samajwadi Party.

clusters.headline: Donald Trump Considers Pardoning Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
aiSummaryBullets: Donald Trump indicated he is considering a potential pardon for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following his return to the technology company.
Jensen Huang issued an apology to Nvidia staff for past actions, while the board faces ongoing scrutiny over the decision to reinstate him as CEO.

clusters.headline: Amit Shah Discusses Security And Reopening The Kartarpur Corridor
aiSummaryBullets: Home Minister Amit Shah confirmed that plans to reopen the Kartarpur Corridor are currently under review.
The official stated that the reopening is contingent upon resolving existing national security concerns.

clusters.headline: Sensex And Nifty Surge As Foreign Investment Boosts Market Today
aiSummaryBullets: The BSE Sensex rose by over 2,000 points while the Nifty50 index surpassed the 25,800 mark.
Market growth was primarily supported by substantial foreign capital inflows into technology and private banking stocks.

clusters.headline: India-Pakistan U19 Cricket Match Controversy Over Neutrality
aiSummaryBullets: Observers raised concerns regarding umpire conduct during the India-Pakistan match following a celebratory gesture toward the Pakistani side.
The Indian cricket team faced criticism for opting to boycott the customary post-match handshake with the Pakistani players.
